label: rust-slice1 single @ ca80bcfa: median of 3 full runs, uncapped; request ids req_<uuid v7> (RFC 9562 method 3); rate-limit windows bounded by their limits; every scenario 0 dropped, 0 failed, 0 missing, 0 pending (writer barrier, exact prefix)
method: scripts/bench-gateway.ts (no --rate), gateway cpus 0-3, upstream 4-5, oha 6-7, 20 s scenarios after a 3 s warmup, OMNI_LOG_LEVEL=warn, OMNI_BENCH=1 (writer barrier: {watermark, committed, failed, dropped}, committed+failed+dropped == watermark, per-scenario deltas), release build. Host checked before each run: no headless Chrome load (chrome gpu 0.0 %), load average 0.7-4.0 (the previous run). Each value is median/min/max of `runs`.
idFormat: Rust mints request ids as req_ + RFC 9562 UUIDv7 (time-ordered, monotonic per process by RFC 9562 method 3: a random 1..2^56 step in rand_a||rand_b within a millisecond); TS mints req_ + UUIDv4. Spec §Writes, "Request ids: time-ordered" (operator decision a4a6de5b).
